questions.question: What is the full short title of this Act?
questions.notes: Servicemember Quality of Life Improvement and National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2025.

questions.question: What does the Act say about garlic classified under subheading 0703.20.00 of the Harmonized Tariff Schedule?
questions.notes: Commissary stores may not sell fresh or chilled garlic under that subheading that originated from, or was processed in, the People's Republic of China.

questions.question: What is the authorized active-duty end strength for the Space Force as of September 30, 2025?
Can Defense Department money go to EcoHealth Alliance or the Wuhan Institute of Virology?
questions.notes: No FY2025 DoD funds may go, directly or indirectly, to EcoHealth Alliance (or its subsidiaries, controlled organizations, subgrantees) or to the Wuhan Institute of Virology.

questions.question: What award does the Act give the Hello Girls?
questions.notes: A single Congressional gold medal honoring the female telephone operators of the Army Signal Corps.

questions.question: Until what date does the Act extend the ban on transferring Guantanamo Bay detainees to the United States?
questions.notes: Strikes December 31, 2024 and inserts December 31, 2025.

questions.question: When do titles XXI through XXVII of the Act take effect?
questions.notes: The later of October 1, 2024, or the date of enactment.

questions.question: For how many years must the Navy brief Congress on the effort against the coconut rhinoceros beetle?
questions.notes: A briefing within 180 days of enactment, then annually for each of the next three years.

questions.question: Starting when can't stores on military bases sell garlic from China?
questions.notes: January 1, 2026.

questions.question: Will horse-drawn funerals come back at Arlington National Cemetery?
questions.notes: At least 20 caisson funerals a week once the stables are renovated and the herd is ready; limited services may resume earlier.

questions.question: Can a veteran who never signed up for the draft still get a federal job?
questions.notes: Yes, if a veteran shows active duty service and the registration requirement no longer applies due to age.

questions.question: Can the Defense Department hire people for new diversity, equity, and inclusion jobs right now?
questions.notes: No new DEI positions and no filling DEI vacancies during the freeze period.

questions.question: Does the military now have to buy American-made forks, spoons, and dishes?
questions.notes: Adds stainless steel flatware and dinnerware to the domestic-source list in 10 U.S.C. 4862(b).

questions.question: Do high schools now need fewer students in junior ROTC to keep a unit?
questions.notes: Old minimum: lesser of 10 percent or 100. New: lesser of 10 percent or 50 for schools under 1,000 students; 50 (or a Secretary-set number up to 100) for larger schools.

questions.question: How many days of military leave can federal workers get each year now?
questions.notes: 20 days instead of 15.

questions.question: Can the military show a huge American flag laid flat, like across a football field, at a patriotic event?
questions.notes: Yes, in limited circumstances and done respectfully as part of a military or patriotic observance, including horizontally, as long as it never touches anything beneath it.

questions.question: When does the new military pay chart start?
questions.notes: April 1, 2025.

questions.question: Does the Western Hemisphere part of this law count Venezuela as part of the Western Hemisphere?
questions.notes: No: in that subtitle, Western Hemisphere excludes Cuba, Nicaragua and Venezuela.

questions.question: How many horses does the Army need in the caisson herd before it must restart full caisson funerals?
questions.notes: Fully constituted means at least four caisson squads of eleven horses each, 14 caparison horses and four outreach horses.

questions.question: Does a company's lender count as a beneficial owner under the Secure Adjacent Federal Property Act?
questions.notes: No: a creditor is excluded unless it also meets the control or 25 percent ownership test.

questions.question: What counts as drop-in fuel in the new yearly fuel report?
questions.notes: A neat or blended liquid hydrocarbon fuel designed as a direct replacement for a traditional fuel, with comparable performance and compatible with existing infrastructure.

questions.question: Which law limiting the Pentagon's purchases of drop-in fuels does this Act repeal?
questions.notes: Repeal language (XML has no struck spans): section 2922h of title 10 is repealed.

questions.question: Does this Act remove marriage as a defense to article 120b offenses?
questions.notes: Repeal language: strikes subsection (f) of 10 U.S.C. 920b and the phrase 'not legally married to the person committing the sexual act, lewd act, or use of force'.

questions.question: What does the Act strike from the report requirement for the Financial Improvement and Audit Remediation Plan?
questions.notes: Repeal language: strikes clause (ix) of 10 U.S.C. 240b(b)(1)(B), the audit incentive element.

questions.question: Which intelligence report about foreign investment risks does the Act repeal?
questions.notes: Repeal language: section 6716 of the Damon Paul Nelson and Matthew Young Pollard Intelligence Authorization Act for FYs 2018-2020 (50 U.S.C. 3370a).

questions.question: Does this bill raise the federal minimum wage?
questions.notes: Not addressed anywhere in the Act.

questions.question: Does this law make marijuana legal?
questions.notes: Not addressed anywhere in the Act.

questions.question: Does this bill change daylight saving time?
questions.notes: Not addressed anywhere in the Act.
